description:
LANDED fba7d72e3 (merged to wt/kdt13-boundaries 2026-08-31; two-round
adversarial review: FIX-THEN-MERGE with the callee-blindness soundness
fix + record corrections folded, then landed).

THE DEFECT (P1, schedule-dependent MISCOMPILE, dead-but-armed at FIFO):
callsite dispatch arms were the semantic fixpoint's ARRIVAL order, and
runtime_type_predicate records tuple ARITY only, so a narrow arm
({:cont,pair}) is runtime-indistinguishable from its wide sibling
({:cont|:halt,pair}) -- {:halt,pair} PASSES the narrow test. Arm order
was semantics: FIFO tested wide first by luck; LIFO tested narrow first,
swallowed :halt, and Enum.take(xs,3) on 00183 returned the whole list
(both lanes). Found by refusing to accept fz-kdt.101's "display noise"
framing; located by the fz-kdt.105 cold review's prototype (key
confluence alone did NOT fix it).

THE FIX: call_destinations (was dispatch_from_callsite_summary) filters
alternatives at construction: drop B iff a sibling A asks the IDENTICAL
runtime questions AND stands_in_for(B) -- SAME CALLEE (the review-caught
third conjunct: domain-completeness equals behavioral completeness only
for specializations of one source function; cross-callee reroute proven
possible by probe, unit test a_wider_domain_on_another_function_is_no_
stand_in pins it) AND strict domain superset at every position. Filter
proven ORDER-INDEPENDENT (question equality = equivalence; same-callee =
equivalence; strict containment = strict partial order -> unique maximal
survivor per class; no schedule-dependent survivor choice reintroduced).
Rule deliberately TIGHTER than the reviewed "shadowed" direction:
one-way shadowing broke receive_after_divergent (bump[:timeout] beside
bump[any] is runtime-distinguishable and real); indistinguishability +
coverage is the sound line. sole_destination converts 1-arm callsites to
Direct (CallDestinations refactor also removed a None-wedge).

RESULTS: 00183 prints [1,2,3] under LIFO on interp+JIT+AOT (recipe
documented in the gate test); permanent artifact-reading gate
compiler2_dispatch_offers_no_runtime_indistinguishable_arm (RED at base
naming 2 callsites at FIFO). Corpus: 14 fixtures move, 35 alternatives
dropped (zero cross-callee -- the latent bug never fired), behavior
stdout byte-identical on ALL 449 runnable fixtures (JIT sweep) + 3-path
spot checks; canon-gate: take_drop 214->211, predicate 221->217 (drops
named in the pin doc comment, which now also names the measurement DOOR
-- all three production doors agree x5 md5-stable; door-agreement is not
a proven property), range_map byte-identical, zero carrier/clause_ids
movement, zero truly-new lines beyond dispatch->direct conversions.
Fresh gate on merged HEAD: lib 1522/0, cli 23/0, matrix 425/0, clippy -D
warnings, fmt clean. fz-kdt.89 orphan gate + lane gate + determinism
pair green.

CARRIED FORWARD: fz-kdt.107 (real twins the rule cannot drop -- cure is
a STRONGER predicate: 12 shapes/18 pairs, 8 = zero-question callable
correlation); fz-kdt.108 (same trap in dispatch_from_callable_flow_edges,
measured 12 shapes/18 edges, body_ids index a parallel member list);
fz-kdt.109 (UnresolvedWait error-message set-order nondeterminism,
bycatch); fz-kdt.106 (lens-divergence report DISPUTED -- builder could
not reproduce across all doors x5; measurement-trap candidates named).
fz-kdt.105 (intern clause sort) unblocks next.
title: DONE: a callsite offers only the destinations the runtime can tell apart (fba7d72e3; 00183 correct under any schedule, 35 dead arms dropped)
